annotation.title_clean: 14 CFR Part 61—Certification: Pilots, Flight Instructors, and Ground Instructors
annotation.title_en: 14 CFR Part 61—Certification: Pilots, Flight Instructors, and Ground Instructors
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), U.S. Department of Transportation
annotation.summary_en: US federal regulation (14 CFR Part 61) setting requirements for certifying pilots, flight instructors and ground instructors, including ratings, medical certificates, training, endorsements and the Robinson R-22/R-44 SFAR. It explicitly excludes unmanned aircraft operations (Part 107) and contains no AI or robotics provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines certificates and ratings for pilots, flight instructors and ground instructors
Medical certificate requirements and durations by certificate class and age
SFAR 73 imposes special training and experience requirements for Robinson R-22/R-44 helicopters until 2029
Student pilot solo flight limitations and instructor endorsement rules
Section 61.8: unmanned aircraft operations under Part 107 cannot count toward Part 61 requirements
